plans.idea: Classic three-column banner true to the original: logo badge anchors the left, a tight text column with the FREE / LIMITED SPOTS pills set as an eyebrow above the headline, and the Save a Seat button centred on the right, all sharing one vertical centre line.

Message-first left-to-right read: a large headline and supporting line fill the left, the CTA and badge pills sit on one baseline row directly beneath the copy, and the round logo closes the composition on the right as a brand seal.

Logo-led two-column lockup: the brand badge on the left beside one left-aligned block where headline, copy, then a CTA-plus-badges action row stack on a shared left edge, keeping the whole offer in a single tight group instead of scattering it across the width.
